verdict.rationale: The Svelte repo describes it as a compiler that turns declarative components into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM, and the docs say it compiles to lean, tightly optimized JavaScript. Developers independently describe its compile-to-imperative-JS model, readable compiled output, snappy apps, and large performance and bundle-size gains after migrating from React. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no virtual DOM diffing occurs, in-depth docs or benchmarks on the update mechanism (one user notes rendering limits at very high element counts).
